The main current offset is offensive-line uncertainty: Baltimore lost Tyler Linderbaum, and leading center candidate Danny Pinter suffered a torn patella tendon on August 20, leaving an unsettled replacement at center.

Contract-hold-in speculation is unconfirmed and has been denied by Shanahan.

3918298.summary: Allen appears fully available after January right-foot surgery for a fractured fifth metatarsal: he completed all of training camp, practiced August 18, and played efficiently with the first offense in the August 15 preseason opener (6-of-8, 111 yards, TD). Joe Brady's promotion creates a head-coach transition, but the offensive system/play-caller continuity and early chemistry with new WR D.J. Moore are modest positives. Connor McGovern's lower-body issue is a minor offensive-line watch item, not yet an Allen availability concern.

His August extension eliminates contract uncertainty, but the Colts have explicitly discussed reducing his 323-carry 2025 workload by finding one or two backs to absorb more touches; that creates a modest volume downside versus a repeat of last season's extreme share.

Ray Davis remains the primary contingency and showed receiving involvement after Cook exited.

His unresolved civil/off-field matter remains a secondary distraction/discipline tail risk, while he has continued to participate in team activities and has not held out over his expiring rookie deal.

The larger 2026 context is favorable after David Montgomery's offseason departure; the Lions have identified Gibbs as the bell-cow, with Isiah Pacheco the clear complementary/backup back. New OC Drew Petzing introduces modest scheme uncertainty, but there is no current indication Gibbs will be unavailable for Week 1.

Continuity between Darnold and Seattle's established WR1, plus a coordinator intending to preserve the prior offensive structure, modestly supports Darnold's passing-game stability.

4430878.summary: Smith-Njigba has participated through camp and remains Seattle's clear WR1 on the official depth chart, with no current injury, holdout, suspension, or off-field availability concern identified. Seattle changed coordinators from Klint Kubiak to first-time play-caller Brian Fleury, but Fleury has explicitly emphasized continuity with the successful 2025 scheme; this is a minor implementation variable rather than a material role downgrade. The surrounding WR depth (Cooper Kupp, Rashid Shaheed, Tory Horton) creates some weekly target competition but does not presently displace JSN's primary role.
